response.sql: WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT c.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS total_spent FROM Customer AS c LEFT JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId), shares AS (SELECT CustomerId, total_spent, 1.0 * total_spent / NULLIF(SUM(total_spent) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM customer_totals), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.total_spent) AS average_total_spent, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG((s.share - b.average_share) / NULLIF(b.average_share, 0)) AS average_relative_difference FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE s.share > b.average_share

assumptions.assumption: Customers with no invoices are included with zero total spent.

alternatives.interpretation: Calculate shares and the benchmark using only customers who have invoices.
